name: Reset – WordPress Database Reset Plugin
author: Smartz Minds

sections.description:
Reset is a powerful WordPress reset plugin that allows you to quickly reset your WordPress database to its default state in just one click.

Whether you want to reset your entire WordPress site, clean database tables, or start fresh, this plugin makes the process simple, fast, and secure.

Perfect for developers, testers, and website owners who need to reset WordPress frequently without reinstalling.

Save time and reset your site instantly without manual cleanup or reinstallation.

🚀 Why Use Reset?

  • One-click WordPress database reset
  • Reset entire site or selected tables
  • Fast, lightweight & secure
  • Safe confirmation system to prevent accidental reset
  • Perfect for developers & testing environments
  • No need to reinstall WordPress

🔥 Key Features

  • Reset WordPress database instantly with one click
  • Selective reset of specific database tables
  • Typing confirmation to avoid accidental reset
  • Fast & secure process with no manual steps
  • Clean database by removing posts, pages, and data
  • Developer-friendly tool for testing and debugging
  • Lightweight plugin with no bloat

💡 Use Cases

  • Reset WordPress site during development
  • Clean database after testing plugins or themes
  • Start fresh without reinstalling WordPress
  • Remove unwanted demo content quickly
  • Prepare site for new projects

⚡ Why Choose Reset Plugin?

Unlike heavy reset plugins, Reset focuses on speed, simplicity, and safety.

  • No unnecessary features
  • No complex setup
  • Fast and reliable reset process
  • Ideal for developers and beginners

📌 How to Reset WordPress Database

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to the Reset menu in dashboard
  3. Enter confirmation text (reset)
  4. Click the Reset button
  5. Your WordPress database will be reset instantly

Video Tutorial:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9cnTu5VCRzg

⚠️ What Will Be Deleted

  • All posts, pages, and custom post types
  • All comments and media entries
  • All users and database tables
  • All plugins and themes (activated or deactivated)

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

What does this WordPress reset plugin do?

It resets your WordPress database to default settings by removing all content and data.

Can I reset only specific tables?

Yes, you can reset the full database or selected tables.

Is it safe to use?

Yes, the plugin includes a confirmation system to prevent accidental resets.

What happens after reset?

Your site will be cleaned, and you will be logged out and logged back in automatically.

Does it delete plugins and themes?

Yes, all plugins and themes are reset or deactivated.

How fast is the reset process?

The reset is instant and works with a single click.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 3.4+
  • PHP 5.x
  • MySQL 5.x

If any problem occurs, please contact us at support@smartzminds.com
